column1: # Game profile of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Switch, updates 4.0.0 = v1441792 and 4.0.1 = v1507328). Plays on the iPhone and the Mac (boot, the title screen's demo race, the Mii pick, the menus, Grand Prix races at 60 fps with sound)
# Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys engine with NintendoWare (G3d, Ui2d, Vfx, Atk) and Pia networking, on SDK 4.4.0, the oldest SDK so far (DARK SOULS: REMASTERED is 4.5.0), NVN;
# subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library (the menus' H.264 previews). RomFS is mostly Yaz0-compressed SARC (.szs), BFRES models and BNTX textures, which the game reads itself.
# Three host parts it needed: the Mii database (hle_mii.c: the six default Miis it lists at boot and never counts, random Miis for the title's demo race), a MiiModel system data
# stand-in (hle_mii.c / hle_fs.c MountSystemData: the firmware's Mii heads are not the host's to ship, so every head is empty and draws nothing), and SDK 4's audio renderer
# (hle_audren.c: its DeviceSink is command 0xf of 0x130 bytes, and the update lock is an nn::os::MutexType at +0x1d0). Its add-on content (0100152000023001) holds only contents.dat
# and version.txt (the courses are in the update): the game decrypts it in a 0x3130-byte heap, which the add-on content cache must leave room in (hle_fs.c romfs_work_size)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

# the race records SetRenderEnableConditional as a course loads: evaluated at replay, as on the GPU (drawn anyway, the same race route at the same frames looked the same; evaluated is NVN's behaviour)
# both merged update copies are extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# no system resource: the game sets a 3.03 GB heap (pool − 64 MB) in the 4 GB layout's 3.25 GB heap region; about 2.4 GB resident and 1.26 GB of Metal allocations in a race on the Mac
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 29,650 shaders (12,529 vertex, 17,092 pixel, 28 compute, 1 geometry): BNSH in the courses' and objects' .bfsha / .bfres archives inside the .szs SARCs, the effects' .ptcl, the layouts,
# agl's two BAHS sharcb and 37 in main; 18,747 variation pairs
